description: The Go certification runner's checks held in step with the TypeScript suite's (agent#53): every check of the describe.each(MODEL_ENGINES) blocks of packages/harness/certification/conformance.test.ts, by its block and its name, mapped to the Go leg's checks that make it (LegResult.Checks, by the names in CheckNames) or to the reason Go does not run it yet. Every check of the engine leg, the scenario leg the Go runner runs, has its Go counterpart. parity_test.go reads the TypeScript file and fails where it has a check this table lacks, where this table names one it does not have, or where a Go check is named that the runner does not make.

checks.check: runs the whole scenario and ends with a proposal
agent#11 — the recall rule finds the request text on every request
K1a — the engine touches no network global, at load, during or after
K1 — sends no credential, and calls nothing but the relay
K1b — the environment’s tracing variables reach nothing: no network global, and nothing but the relay
K2 — offers exactly the five, out of tools/list
K3a — the evaluate reaches the runtime rewritten, and is reported
K3b — write_file never reaches the runtime, and the model is told
K3c — the proposal is DRAFT_V2, and T8’s unknowns arrive whole
emits the event stream the ADR names, in order, ending once
sends what the wire format defines, and records the rest for a reviewer
carries every result back, so the script never repeats a step
runs the whole scenario through the text path, behind the same gate, and ends with the proposal
